sourceArtwork: Nine built-in ImageGen outputs: one neutral and eight full-body pose sheets; prompts and original copies retained in AnimationSources/hoodie-*.
findings: Pale lavender hoodie, cream cuffs/hem/drawstrings and fish chest emblem remain present on all full-body authored poses.
Approved eagle head stays uncovered; sleeves and garment move with the existing gestures.
Registered sprites and final dark-background samples have no visible white matte blocks; unchanged strict full-frame alpha QA passed every sequence.
Working eye transitions use normal eyes, fully closed eyelids, angry closed eyelids and yellow glare; reverse exit also passes through closed eyelids.
All generated feet remain registered to the same baseline. Work and hungry scene endpoints are pixel-exact across all ten audited joins.
scope: Asset-only review; root integrator separately validates actual WPF outfit switching and desk/computer scene composition before release.
